definitions.full: H1726. daharah [ דַּהֲרָה ] noun feminine rushing, dashing , of riders — Plural construct אַבִּירָיו דַּהֲרוֺת דַּהֲרוֺת Judg 5:22 ; repetition for intensity, furious dashing .
